experiment.topic: Hourly trend persistence in BTC-USD across regimes
experiment.hypothesis: A 20-hour trend in BTC-USD price persistence is statistically robust across all historical regimes, with a minimum 5% threshold for trend continuation.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If, over a 20-hour lookback, the hourly close price of BTC-USD fails to maintain a directional trend (i.e., no sustained upward or downward movement) in at least 80% of the 2020-2026 historical periods, then the hypothesis is falsified.
